decision: Switch the backend back to the existing localhost:5432/productdb connection and remove only the verified temporary pm_postgres container publishing host port 55432. Preserve all volumes and leave my_postgres_db untouched.
rationale: The requested operational state is the original database service on port 5432, with the temporary database container removed but its named volume retained.
configuration: dotenv.env already contains DATABASE_URL for localhost:5432/productdb, so no configuration change is planned.
sensitive_data: Do not record or emit the requested login password, password hashes, cookies, or tokens.
